lines.speaker: npc.parish_priest
lines.text: The roof, Mr. Varelas. Rain comes in over the Sacred Heart. And the Greeks.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: My church is uptown, Father. But rain is ecumenical. Two hundred.

lines.speaker: npc.parish_priest
lines.text: God bless you. Your name goes on the plaque. Small letters, if you prefer.
